in_sanskrit.name: धुर्व
in_sanskrit.meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'dhru' meaning 'to hold, support, or sustain'
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The exact meaning of the name 'Dhurv' in Sanskrit is not definitively known, but it is believed to be derived from the root 'dhru' which means 'to hold, support, or sustain'. In Hindu mythology, Dhurv is the name of a sage who is said to have performed a great penance and obtained a boon from Lord Shiva, granting him the power to create the universe in an instant.

in_marathi.name: Dhurv
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the Cosmos
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhurv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhurv is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dhruva', which means 'fixed' or 'stable'.
